## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new feature)

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch targets `main` (no direct pushes to `main`; PRs only)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits and end with the
      `Generated by Mistral Vibe.` / `Co-Authored-By: Mistral Vibe <vibe@mistral.ai>` trailers
- [ ] AI co-authorship disclosed below (see "AI assistance")
- [ ] Contribution complies with the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] CI gate run locally: `python -m compileall -q src tests` and `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] Woodpecker CI passes (`.woodpecker.yml`); GitHub Actions is used only for CodeQL scanning
- [ ] Never deploy from a feature branch; deploys need explicit per-occurrence operator approval
